reviews.reviewText: Overloading ke related 4 se 6 MCQs thay. Ek question switch statement se tha (salary lo user se, deduction batao aur total). Do questions ke output batane thay aur ek mein error find karna tha.

Paper 8 Aug 12 PM ko tha. MCQs zyada tar handouts se aaye, files se sirf 5 ya 6 percent thay. Output operator overloading aur logical operations se related questions thay. For loop ka output poocha gaya, public aur private class ka question tha. setfill aur setw se related output bhi aayi jaisa ke cout<<setfill("*")<<setw(10)<<750;.

Multiple Choice Questions easy thay aur kuch programs ki output ya errors identify karne se related thay. Short questions mein array ki output, pi aur circle ke circumstances poochay gaye. Long questions mein matrices ka program aur WS Manipulator aur input handling ka scenario explain karna tha.

MCQs 25 thay jo classes, structure, pointer, array aur pointer relation par based thay. Subjective mein circle ka area aur circumference calculate karna tha. Volume class bana kar getter setter likhna tha. For loop program mein errors find karni thin. Oldcar aur newcar classes se related question tha aur aik question structures par based tha.

MCQs mostly easy aur kuch conceptual thay. Long mein 4 programs ki output likhni thi jisme salary, grocery, travel, medical, utility aur tax calculation thi. Count, endl aur int ka difference bhi poocha gaya.
Subjective part mein errors of resolution, 4 by 4 matrix ka code, 2 by 2 matrix nested loop ke through aur objects se related questions aaye.
